# Native routing characterization fixture

`PlayerConversationRoutingPolicy.h` is an exact copy of the raw stock CHIM policy used for the host-only S1 characterization test. It comes from [CHIM revision 5ca1bc361d1e11a3c58067599b494b1101c2c77b](https://github.com/Dwemer-Dynamics/CHIM/blob/5ca1bc361d1e11a3c58067599b494b1101c2c77b/Plugin/PlayerConversationRoutingPolicy.h), path `Plugin/PlayerConversationRoutingPolicy.h`, SHA-256 `e4038ab63819bb72a7188e7e8d0a224ca2aa82bba8255031d6920de69baa7f1c` (20,139 bytes). The header copy is unmodified.

`Plugin-LICENSE` preserves the MIT license text from the same pinned source revision at `Plugin/LICENSE`, with CRLF line endings (1,094 bytes; SHA-256 `2b26f5544da33f92dce7108279124fe60fb59863ef23c2b2c79c814aefbe6fc4`). Upstream LF bytes are 1,073 bytes; SHA-256 `1cc6beea175810eeea292ea8d7a917265d811cb356ca3c36304669e213eefe0c`. Its copyright placeholder, `Copyright (c) 2022 <YOUR NAME HERE>`, is preserved verbatim; no author is inferred.

The test characterizes the raw selection policy only; it does not simulate Skyrim or establish the final in-game speaker.
